title: Allows the borders within the table to share an edge
goal: uses border-collapse, cell padding and alignment styles to improve table readability.
summary: The equipment number table requires clear grid lines and a little space in the cells. Numbered columns are individually right aligned.
tasks: uses collapsing borders for the table. Set 1px solid line #9aa9b5 and 8px padding for th, td.
The .code number and title of the number column are right aligned.

example.code:
table { border-collapse: collapse; }
th, td { border: 1px solid #999; padding: .5rem; }
example.note: folding model allows the grid lines of adjacent cells to merge. padding determines the distance from the content to the edge.

hint: border folding is set in table; grid is set in each th and td.
